title: Townsman
summary: TOWNS'MAN, noun [town and man.] An inhabitant of a place; or one of the same town with another. 1. A selectman; an officer of the town in New England, who assists in managing the affairs of the town.

inlines.v: TOWNS'MAN, noun [town and man.] An inhabitant of a place; or one of the same town with another. 1. A selectman; an officer of the town in New England, who assists in managing the affairs of the town. [See Selectmen.] TOWN'-TALK, noun [town and talk.] The common talk of a place, or the subject of common conversation.
